the most stable element in the universe. Just like the atom
of helium has two electrons, spinning aroung the nucleus, 
your ship has two satellites spinning around central unit.
They create a protective field to separate the human pilot
from deadly radioactivity.

You have been selected for the mission of retrieving the
isotopes. Good luck, you will need it.

200901.overview:
Written to celebrate International Museum Day 2012, at the request of the museum IAACC Pablo Serrano from Zaragoza (Spain).

You can also come to Zaragoza to play the game live in the museum IAACC Pablo Serrano.

200903.overview:
Dedicated to the memory of Emilio Salgueiro. 
Recent events had taught Phantomas that the only way to tackle an evil was at its roots. For centuries, a mysterious civilization hidden somewhere in the Andromeda nebula, had ruled the fates of the Universe in a covert way. Through small blows of effect, he had done and undone at ease in the course of events. He had overthrown kings, placed others, tipped the balance towards the most propitious side in battles, ruined rich countries or raised nauseating pigsty to the finest of luxuries. The last traces of its existence, found on the Andromeda ship that went to crash into the Bassard Asteroid, where Phantomas was confined, had been revealing: ancient as the universe, its branches spanned the eight octants of the Universe.

200904.overview:
For centuries, rumours about a secret, mythical and mysterious civilization have travelled across the open wide space. Such civilization, inhabiting the dark and dangerous deepest caves from Mars, is dedicated to treasure tons of cubic gold, the finest and purest in the Universe. Nobody has ever seen them, but nobody will deny their existence. They simply “are”, but you just “can’t see them”.

For years, Phantomas has been tracing such mysterious civilization. Since he decided to give up his life of steal and robbery that he was designed for, after rebelling against his very own and deepest roots, he just wanted to build a place to live and rest forever, far away, on the planet Novgorod, between the basaltic mountains of Ngailhadam and the mercury rivers Hyarespone and Mithralaigáhn. Something that ambitious could only be taken care using the expensive cubic gold from Mars. It would be the last raid for Phantomas, before retiring to have his well-deserved rest after freeing the Universe from the dark conspirators from Andromeda.

Almost by chance, Phantomas discovered an intercommunication while he was searching a piece of terrain in the surface of Mars. Laboriously tracing such signal, he could find its origin and discover, full of joy, the whereabouts of one of the mines where the cubic gold was extracted by the legendary unknown civilization.

200905.overview:
The mysterious acolytes of the Vehjstiahows sect finally dominated the old Metro City, an ancient place formerly known for its explendour (in arts, culture, and good weath!), but which had became a decrepit and rusty ruin since. Cultivating assassin celery, they had developed an evil formula which had contamined the sewers with “goblin snot”, a substance which was capable of turning bricks in big, fat gold coins (just like those which can be seen in “Uwol, Quest For Money”).

Far away, Phantomas was celebrating his 25th Birthday jumping in a trampoline with a naked woman eating tortilla, but in a sudden he felt like reading a random page from the Galactic History and Table Games Encyclopedia, which contained all that you need to know about table games and galactic history from year 4 until right now. Avidly reading, he found about the Vehjstiahows and decided that the best way to celebrate his birthday going back to his old ways: traveling there and stealing all the big fat gold coins he could.

200914.overview: In the role of the female android, you must go through the Phantomas fortress to capture it and take it to your mentor in search of answers to your own existence. Phantoma's fortress is divided into two sectors, separated from each other by a complex security system

200920.overview: Pietro the carpenter and his brother Luizo are at it again! This time Pietro and Luizo were transported to pipe world after eating some rancid mushrooms on his pizza for a psychodelic trip where they believe are being invaded by crawling pests! Team up with a friend or brave it alone and help Pietro and Luizo battle the crawling pests! And remember: winners don't use pokes™

200922.overview:
Pipeline is conversion of an existing C64 game "Super Pipeline"; however in those days conversion meant complete rewrite, causing the game to have a completely different feel.
Your job in this game is to keep a pipeline flowing with water. This pipeline will be disrupted by a falling plug from above this line. Your workman assisting you to repair the possible plugs caused. Critters are around the pipeline and will kill you if they touch you.

200923.overview: Pipeline is a puzzle game and a  game similar to Pipe Dream (which was released years later), published as a type-in in a Spectrum magazine called Sinclair Programs -  from issue #7 - 1983/May. Instead of controlling the flow of a liquid, this one plays against a CPU opponent where the goal is to either build a working pipeline all the way to the top or force the opponent off from the board.

200931.overview:
Forced to clean up the dog turd and rid the parck of drunkards and flashers who are making a nuisance of themselves.

Working together as a team you will have to overcome many obstacles and puzzles to accomplish your task.

200936.overview:
You are Merlin's son, and you stand before the plain of the shrinking men. You know that you must fulfill a mission, and you know that it will not be easy. However, you will do everything possible, because if you succeed, the spirit of your father, Merlin the magician, will emerge from the ancient oak tree and all his power will be transmitted to you. As you prepare for battle, you remember your escape from your adoptive parents' house. You also remember the rage that invaded your young body when you learned of the betrayal with which Nimiane, the Lady of the Lake, paid your father. She deceived the king of the magicians, captivating him with her beauty, convinced him to teach her all his magic, and then turned against him! You are Merlin's son, called Gareth, and today you will shed blood, send souls to the darkest hell, and save your father. 

You will use physical and magical weapons. Nothing must stop you.  It's not for nothing that two years have passed since you fled, it's not for nothing that you've trained in swordplay, you've learned to strike with all your strength, you know how to throw Bland balls. It's not for nothing that you've read forgotten books on sorcery, you've managed to master necromancy and now the power of the dead accompanies you with all its mysterious magic.

200994.overview:
Agent 98 is one day from retirement, thus revoking his permit to murder. Who should show up in this small timeframe, non other that nemesis and major crime boss Leche Lacto.
Agent, take down Lacto's drug and money laundering empire and enjoy your well earned retirement.
Good Luck!

200995.overview:
Many, many years ago, a young boy named Poe was transformed into a scarecrow for stealing candies from the home of a powerful sorcerer.

However, the gods of magic were angry with the wizard for using this magic in such a way so they made a deal with Poe.

Every Halloween night, he will be brought to life and must try to steal all the wizard's candies again. If he manages to do so, and amuse the gods, then they will force the wizard to break the curse and make him human once more!

Be prepared to dodge and bounce over the denizens of the underworld, who are all ready to do the bidding of the old sorcerer in their quest to put a stop to your antics! Make your way through many different areas as you try to break the curse that has lain over you for so long.

Experience all the thrills and chills of Halloween night in this charming (and chilling) platformer from Ariel Endaraues.

200996.overview:
Leonardo, won a ticket for the maiden voyage of the greatest
ship ever built, the "Titanic", where he meet Kate, a girl of
his dreams, but their love was forbidden. Kate was rich,
Leonardo was pooe and a thief.

This was not the only problem...

Pussy is a platform game with some action levels, you play
Leonardo and the objective is to get in touch with Kate.
Leonardo can not jump in most levels, but his fists are capable
to smash a kind of bricks, and he can climb ladders. If Leo will
smash a brick, all bricks over this one will fall down by one
field, there are also teleport doors (very common on the
original "Titanic") and a lot of enemies.

201082.overview:
Welcome to Mars, the red planet. Meet the gotesque martians who still 
there for doom. Leds to our hero within the old space station to 
dynamite the whole area and stop his evil inhabitants.

The mission is to find 10 exlosive barrels, bring they to the center of
the planet and back to the control center to activate the detonation.

In your trip you can take air bottles to refill your breath.

There are some ammunition packs provides you 20 bullets.

Also you need cards to pass to restricted areas.

The first aid kit give you an extra live.

201563.overview:
Limited to 80 copies and exclusively available through a Spanish crowdfunding platform, this is the first official release of The Prayer of the Warrior, a game made available on a cassette tape with a box and a colour manual. 

The original game was made in 1991/1992 for ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC and PC to be published by Zigurat, but was eventually never released. While since 2003 both the Spectrum and CPC versions have been recovered and improved by the community, this ZX Spectrum release in Spanish is the only official version of the game made available with the help of the original authors. Even though it has no music and has a number of known bugs it is released exactly in the same state it was meant to be published in the 90s, as the original authors did not want to interfere with the original choices and design. 

In this 2D fantasy game the player controls a warrior who is humanity's last hope against the army of the evil king Arihman who has brought darkness to the world. The game is divided into two chapters (El bosque de Aqueron and La morada de Arihman) with an intro and an outro. The character is guided through a game world of single-screen rooms that are connected horizontally and vertically offering a large amount of free exploration. 

The warrior starts with three lives and there is a health bar as he can take multiple hits. He navigates platforms, can jump and attacks enemies with an axe. Objects in the environment can be destroyed and there are many hazards and traps such as spikes suddenly appearing. Enemies often keep respawning endlessly without a means to stop them permanently. Some items can be picked up to restore health. 

A chapter ends with a boss but in the first chapter to face it a large number of vases need to be destroyed. This builds up the image of a vase in the bottom left side of the screen and once all vases have been destroyed and the image is complete, a talisman appears in the inventory and the boss can be faced to end the stage. The second chapter has a different environment, palette and gameplay. There are other items to collect and a torch is used as often only small parts of the environment can be lightened while the rest of the screen remains dark.

201583.overview:
Ptarmigan is a 1985 text adventure for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Angus Appleby and published by 5D Software Services.

Plot:

Find the golden ring in the underground city of Ptarmigan and place it on the correct pedestal to restore the city.

201970.overview: Rescue your uncle kidnapped by an indigenous tribe hidden deep in the jungle. You will have to return all their gold if you want to make your way through their temple and be able to rescue your uncle.

207809.overview: Pirate 3 +3 is three Great Games for the Spectrum +3. Including Holiday in Sumeria, Call Me Psycho and Smash Out!

207813.overview: Slovak text adventure game that was recently re-released in English. After your 1st success (in the last game), the feared Cosa Nostra has shown an interest. You've been sent to a pacific island of Bukapao. The task: Kill the island president - Amatom Bugampa, who's been obstructing the flow of American drugs to the Pacific, and ruining your bosses'  business. Customs are strict, so you go to the island "for pleasure" by the Adria cruise ship. The gun you need must be obtained there.

207814.overview: A Slovak created text adventure recently translated into English by the original creators. In some ways this is more of a menu-driven "simulation" than a text adventure. In it you are a contract killer that must make your way to success amongst the seedy side of the world.

207815.overview: A Slovak text adventure recently re-released in English based around the subject of computer hacking and system penetration. It is an unofficial sequel to The Stig 3, by Fuxoft and there is important info that can help a user in this game. The story takes place in the (then) near future of 1991 in New York. You play as Tim Coleman, a programmer\hacker and your job is to hack Jack Ragger and clean out his accounts.

213110.overview:
Young Jones sets off in search of Bartolo's flute, the one with only one hole. 
Her latest investigations of him place her hidden deep within the Blue Grotto.
Legend has it that the power of said flute is superhuman and makes you dominate 
the art of music like nobody else...

213733.overview:
Pilot Attack is a horizontal scrolling shoot 'em up which has some similarities to Scramble for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Misfit, and published by The Future Was 8 Bit in 2017.

The digital version is available for free (or name your own price) on Misfit's itch.io page.

216312.overview: Perseus is a text adventure that  lets you play the classic tale of how the hero of Attica amd the son of Zeus  slew Medusa and gained himself a bride.

419781.overview:
You discover the entrance to an ancient Pharaoh's tomb, blocked by a rock.  If you are skillful, you can get in and take all the treasures - but beware!  The Pharaohs did not build their tombs without making quite sure that their possessions were properly guarded. 

A graphical text adventure.

421670.overview: The first of a multiple text adventures based on the British 60s TV series of the same name, The Prisoner follows the plot of the series in which you play a secret agent "Number Six", who has been abducted to a bizarre prison that looks like an idyllic village from the outside. Your mission: escape!

440313.overview: A classic game of billiards in which the player's task is to pot all of their balls into the pocket, and finally the black ball, in order to win. Pocketing the black ball too early causes the opponent to win the current game. Hitting an opponent's ball or pocketing the cue ball is a foul that gives the opponent an extra turn. The player plays until they pocket their ball. If this happens, the opponent begins their turn.

451155.overview:
Play it Again is a collection of six games plus one free game which consists of the following games:

10th Frame
Metro Cross
Leaderboard
Supercycle
Express Raider
Impossible Mission

Plus the free game:

Leaderboard Tournament

452444.overview:
Chess or Psion Chess was developed for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum 48K by Psion Software Ltd, in collaboration with Mikro-Gen Ltd. The program featured:

.- High-resolution graphics for the chessboard and pieces
.- Ten levels of difficulty, with level 2 being a challenging opponent
.- Efficient machine code implementation

453033.overview:
Paddington's Garden Game is a game based on the character from the books by Michael Bond, where you play Paddington Bear who is spending a week in the country and has decided to catch butterflies. The game is a flick-screen maze game viewed from above at an elevated angle and is aimed at children between the ages of five to eight. You move around the countryside looking for different coloured butterflies, each with a unique name which are Wilbur, Geoff, Boswold, Cyril and Mandy and are worth different points. To catch a butterfly you only have to touch it and you automatically use your net to capture it.

Also on the various screens are hedgehogs and wasps which move around and these must be avoided or you lose one of three lives. The walls of flowers and other obstacles should also be avoided as you also lose a life when touched. As well as a your score you are also trying to complete the game as fast as you can which is saved as well as the score. Once you lose all three lives then it is game over but you do watch the butterflies being released back into the wild.

453344.overview:
A collection of five action-packed games, with 2 of Rainbow Arts' technically-advanced original titles alongside 3 arcade conversions. The list is:

Rainbow Islands
Chase H.Q.
Altered Beast
Turrican
X-Out

453485.overview:
Panther is set on the human colony Xenon, which is attacked by aliens. The priority is to evacuate the people, but unfortunately not everyone made it. The player takes the role of a pilot who mans the Panther aircraft to save the last remaining humans.

The game is a shooter with an isometric view. The player can move left and right and adjust the height. Reverse is not available, and the movement speed depends on the height: the higher, the faster. This is most important when alien attack occurs. They always appear in batches and their shadows indicate their height. Now the player has the choice to evade or to fight back. However, the Panther can only take five hits.

To evade people, the player needs to land near them and wait until everyone is in. The game consists of several levels, and the last has an additional gameplay mechanic: SAMs. Those mean the player can't fly high enough to go over the skyscrapers; he needs to fly around them. After reaching the evacuation ship, the game loops back to the beginning; the goal being to reach a high score by saving many people.

Unlike the original Commodore 64 version, and the Atari 8-bit port, the Spectrum version was not made by Sculptured Software, and was ported by M.C. Lotharien.

454235.overview:
Wee Knight, his chain-mail dusted with the clinging shadows of the forest he'd just escaped, surveyed the alien landscape. Gone were the oppressive darkness and the mocking glow of unseen eyes. In their place sprawled the stark majesty of countless pyramids, their golden caps gleaming under a double sun. Were these the forgotten monuments of a long-lost civilization, or the handiwork of extraterrestrial pharaohs? The answer, it seemed, lay within the very stones themselves.

Wee Knight's spaceship, a cobbled-together marvel, lay in smoldering ruins behind him. But despair was a luxury Wee Knight couldn't afford. The four chests hidden within the treacherous forest had yielded not just escape, but knowledge. Ancient blueprints whispered of a powerful artifact – the dragon stone – rumored to hold the key to interplanetary travel. The whispers also spoke of four scarab shaped keys, hidden within the largest pyramid, guarding the sarcophagi that held the dragon stones long forgotten location.

This, then, was his new quest. To navigate the labyrinthine depths of the colossal pyramid and claim the legendary dragon stone. Only then could Wee Knight escape this world of golden dunes. With a resolute glint in his eye, Wee Knight adjusted his helmet and strode towards the looming pyramid, its entrance a gaping maw whispering promises of adventure... and peril!

457469.overview:
Discovered on a set of tapes at Ocean by Mark R. Cobley-Jones, who was working at Ocean at the time as a graphic artist. He found the tape in 1988 within a load of rubbish and saved a copy to a Microdrive at Ocean. It was then forgotten about until around 2015, when Mark found it again and managed to salvage it.

Was sent around to a number of companies at the time, including Ocean, and was never picked up – probably due to the copyright issues (there is even a drawing of Popeye on the loading screen!). The game was never advertised by anyone, but it was completely finished.

462283.overview: Peking is a video game adaptation of Solitaire Mahjong, or Shanghai. It was released on the covertape for Your Sinclair Issue #73. Your Sinclair readers voted it the 35th best ZX Spectrum game of all time in the magazine's final issue.

462994.overview:
Year: 2376 In a future where pets have become the most coveted commodity on the black market, their transporters are under constant attack from saboteurs and pirates. As a result, hundreds of animals have been scattered across the most dangerous corners of the planet.

To counter this threat, elite squads have been formed—dedicated to rescuing lost furry companions and eliminating hostile mutants. One of the most legendary teams is led by the fearless Captain Cat, aboard the ReefShark II: a hybrid vehicle capable of gliding through the air, diving into murky waters, and flying over infested zones.  

Each time you deliver a puppy to the corresponding station, or eliminate a fly or an octopus, your energy will increase.

463508.overview: A text adventure authored with the Quill Adventure System.

464054.overview:
The alien craft are armed with heavy laser cannons and are very intelligent.  If you succeed in clearing them from a sector, you will be attacked by hunter craft which fire homing missiles at you.

Your craft are armed with a laser and (the famous Abacus) guided missiles.  It can rotate or thrust at two speeds.  In addition to destroying the transmitters, you are supposed to clear a path through the very dense debris, so that your battle fleet may advance safely.

471847.overview:
Walter can use a bucket or a fire extinguisher to fight the fire. He can also use his extending ladder to create a new escape route. Doors can be opened by Walter hot-footing it past  them. Once all the foam is used the extinguisher vanishes.

Empty buckets can be filled from taps found around the building. Dynamite should be removed to safety as quickly as possible, and yes, that is a pink elephant on the top floor, dancing and dousing!

Score points for inmates rescued and for valuables salvaged, also a bonus for fast fire-fighting. Extra lives if all are saved and after every eighth screen.
